metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a Rust Cargo CLI simulator in:

- [Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml)
- [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs)

It builds and runs with:

- `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`
- `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- <arguments>`

I also verified a smoke test with trace output and JSON emission (`--input`, `--output`, `--trace-output`, `--trace-time-step`) and confirmed successful build/run plus file generation.
